title: Photoresponsive molecular tweezers modulate Taspase 1 activity

“Claws Out!”: Molecular tweezers equipped with photoswitchable linkers dynamically open and close their “claws” on irradiation. This structural transition allows precise, reversible control over proteolytic activity in a light-dependent manner.
